userRequest: GPT IMAGE 사용, 경로는 실제 경로처럼

prompts.initial:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final production-ready symbol for AIRO / 아이로, a premium AI travel companion website. Create ONE standalone logo symbol, not a presentation board.
Primary request: Design an original, striking, beautifully proportioned abstract A monogram that feels confident, dynamic and sophisticated. Combine the silhouette of an uppercase A with a single ascending travel trajectory. Construct it from two substantial geometric ribbon-like strokes and one precise negative-space cut. Give the silhouette a subtle forward lean and a memorable asymmetric notch; evoke a route unfolding into a destination through shape alone. It should feel like a serious, crafted identity, not an illustration or a generic AI badge.
Style: impeccably clean, flat, vector-like geometry, sharp intentional cuts with just slightly softened outer corners, optical balance, bold enough to work at 24px. The folded-ribbon impression must come from silhouette and negative space, not shading. Restrained, contemporary editorial design.
Color: symbol entirely solid pale pistachio #D5E6B4. This symbol will appear on the existing near-black #0A0A0A website. All negative space and the full canvas background must be genuinely transparent alpha, including inside the monogram.
Composition: square canvas, one large centered symbol taking approximately 84% of the canvas width and height, evenly balanced transparent margins. No rounded-square container or background tile.
Text: none. No wordmark, letters outside the single abstract A symbol, captions, sample sizes or explanations.
Avoid: sparkles, four-point stars, location-pin outlines, hearts, globe illustrations, airplane clipart, thin line art, gradients, metallic surfaces, shadows, lighting effects, 3D renders, mockups, multiple variants, watermarks. Do not imitate another company's logo.
Return a clean transparent PNG logo asset.
prompts.routeRevision:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Input image: the supplied transparent AIRO A monogram is the edit target.
User correction: the route inside the logo must look like an actual route on a map.
Change ONLY the route treatment inside the A. Preserve the bold outer A silhouette, its proportions, pale pistachio color, position, transparent background, and clean flat graphic style.
Replace the existing broad swooping arrow with a convincing minimalist map-navigation route: a continuous, evenly weighted negative-space path with two or three deliberate street-like bends and softly rounded corners, progressing from lower left toward upper right through the body of the A. It must resemble following real streets, not a swoosh, flight trajectory, racing stripe, lightning bolt, or arrow. Integrate a small circular departure point and a slightly larger destination point into the route. No arrowhead anywhere.
Make the route optically balanced and easy to recognize at 32px. Use just enough bends to communicate a real map route while keeping the logo premium and simple. Do not add a street map or background grid. The A remains one cohesive bold symbol.
Flat solid pale pistachio #D5E6B4 artwork only. The path, counters, and full canvas background must be genuinely transparent alpha. Clean antialiased edges. No text, wordmark, star, container, shadows, gradients, mockup, extra symbols, or multiple variants. Return ONE transparent PNG.
prompts.discardedTransparencyAttempt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the provided pale pistachio A logo with a street-route cutout.
Preserve the logo's outer silhouette and the complete interior street route, including both circular endpoints, exactly.
Remove ALL the visible gray checkerboard pixels, including the ones outside the A, inside the route, and in the bottom counter of the A. The checkerboard is an unwanted printed background, not part of the artwork.
The final file must be a genuinely transparent PNG with a real alpha channel. Do not draw, simulate, or include a checkerboard. Do not substitute a black, white, gray, or colored background.
Keep only the pale pistachio A-shaped artwork, with clean antialiased edges. Every background and route-cutout pixel must have zero alpha. Keep the same square framing and scale. No redesign, no text, no mockup, no border, no added elements. Return the isolated logo on actual transparency.
prompts.finalMaskExport:
Create a production monochrome bitmap mask from the supplied A logo. This is a BLACK AND WHITE logo export, NOT a transparent-background image.
Keep exactly the existing A silhouette and the internal street-route geometry with its two round endpoints. Do not redesign anything.
Make the A artwork pure solid WHITE (#FFFFFF). Make the entire background, internal route, endpoint circles, and the bottom triangular counter pure solid BLACK (#000000).
Absolutely no checkerboard, no gray pattern, no transparency visualization, no green, no shadows, no texture, no gradients. Flat opaque black and white pixels, with only clean antialiasing along the contour.
The final image must look like a white printed logo on a completely solid black square. Preserve the composition and margins of the input. One logo only, no text.

notes: Final master is the GPT Image monochrome logo with street-like bends and circular endpoints. It is rendered through a luminance mask in the existing brand color. The checkerboard-background revisions were not deployed. No manually drawn logo geometry is used.
